text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFe-Co OER screening batch 14 - routine calcination","campaign_class":"standard_oer_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"confirm current plate before batch"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-FTO-0142","label":"standard FTO plate"},"comment":"swap to fresh plate"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-FTO-0142"},"comment":"routine init"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"baseline NiFeCo ternary, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":850,"duration":360,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard calcination step per SOP-OER-3, same as previous batches","label":"routine_calcination"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0]},"comment":"select point"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"standard CP at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"batch14"},"comment":"update GP surrogate"},{"server":"durability_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":24},"comment":"short stability check"}]}
